newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies seven issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies seven issues for bond insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said it qualified for insurance seven bond issues slated for competitive sale on Thursday.
--Tippecanoe Elementary School, Ind., $22.5 million of first mortgage bonds.
--Marion County USD #408, Kan., $3.5 million of general obligation (GO) school bonds.
--Perry Public School, Mich., $2.4 million of school building bonds.
--Arlington CSD, N.Y., $20 million of school district bonds.
--Syosset CSD, N.Y., $8.3 million of school district bonds.
--Williams/Travis MU, Texas, $2.8 million of tax and revenue securities.
